newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: Renewal recommended for U.N. Golan Heights force.
newsitem.headline: Renewal recommended for U.N. Golan Heights force.

text.p: Secretary-General Boutros Boutros-Ghali on Friday recommended another six-month renewal, until May 31, 1997, of the 1,040-member U.N. force which has served as a buffer between the Syrian and Israeli armies on the Golan Heights since 1974.

In a written report to the Security Council, he said U.N. members owed more than $64 million for the upkeep of the force -- equivalent to twice its current annual budget -- and appealed for assessments to be paid promptly and in full.

The U.N. Disengagement Observer Force (UNDOF), as it is officially called, includes troops from Austria, Canada, Japan and Poland, under the command of Major-General Johannes Kosters of the Netherlands.
